INSERT INTO pages (id, org_id, course_id, slug, title, current_version_id, created_at,
                              updated_at)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6,
                   timestamptz 'epoch' + $7::bigint * interval '1 microsecond',
                   timestamptz 'epoch' + $7::bigint * interval '1 microsecond')
